title: Rank weighting and asymmetry in Blest's rank correlation: two exact regions
summary: Blest's rank correlation $ν$ is a variant of Spearman's rho $ρ$ that weights the leading ranks of one variable more heavily, at the price that $ν$ is not symmetric in its arguments. We quantify both features by determining the exact region of $(ρ,ν)$ over all bivariate copulas, as well as that of $(η,ν)$, where $η$ is the symmetrized Blest coefficient of Genest and Plante. The latter region is a linear image of the set of all pairs $(ν(C),ν(C^\top))$ formed by a copula $C$ and its transpose.
